subject: Unforeseen mechanical field condition: unforeseen ceiling height restriction affecting

messages.text: Our crew hit the unforeseen ceiling height restriction affecting the ductwork routing at RTU-2 and need your call on the permanent fix. This needs immediate attention; please respond as soon as possible. This condition will require a change order. This is holding up work in this area. Please respond Thursday so we can keep the crew moving.
Reroute to clear the conflict at RTU-2 per the attached sketch; proceed once you've confirmed clearance. This condition will require a change order.
